data.name: Heroes of Arcania
data.detailed_description:
When heroes are needed, they shall arise!

Heroes of Arcania is a tabletop-inspired card and board game designed to deliver a fast-paced yet expansive RPG experience, perfect for both new and veteran players.

In this demo, you can choose one of three heroes, purchase equipment, potions, and/or NPCs and jump straight into the action to experience the core mechanics for yourself!

The full tabletop edition goes far beyond what’s available here, featuring 500+ unique cards—including Heroes, NPCs, Equipment, Potions, Spells, and more. It also includes a Story Book, Instruction Booklet, four Hero Boards for multiplayer play, custom dice and markers, and 200 real metal coins.

Three expansions are planned for release shortly after the core game launches, with ten more in development, offering a near-endless supply of quests, upgrades, and adventure.

All assets in this demo are based on the Second Edition of the tabletop game (currently in development) with some adjustments to better fit this digital format.

To learn more about the full tabletop experience, you can visit the official website.

So what say you, hero? Will you heed the call to adventure?

Inspired by classic fantasy card and board games, this demo provides a bite-sized look at the combat, mechanics, and flow of the full game — perfect for learning the ropes before diving into the complete tabletop adventure!
